items.text: Every other turn, starting on turn 1 of each battle, add 1 Temporary Right arrow to your hand after your opening draw for that turn.
Every other turn, starting on turn 1 of each battle, add 1 Temporary Up arrow to your hand after your opening draw for that turn.
Every other turn, starting on turn 1 of each battle, add 1 Temporary Down arrow to your hand after your opening draw for that turn.
Every other turn, starting on turn 1 of each battle, add 1 Temporary Left arrow to your hand after your opening draw for that turn.
